task_description: Wire the Merchant Console Transactions page end-to-end against real data (SLICE 1). Implement two new control-plane-api GET endpoints backed by a merchant-scoped read-model projection over runtime.workflow_intents + lifecycle_steps + spend_ledger, enforce tenant isolation, and replace the hardcoded DEMO_TRANSACTIONS array in apps/merchant-console/src/app/transactions/page.tsx with a real useApi(listTransactions) fetch (loading/empty/error states). Prove against live Supabase with a creds/DB-gated integration test that seeds and cleans up its own rows. Scope guardrail: ONLY the Transactions slice; do not touch other pages or consoles.

verification.summary: pnpm build clean; pnpm test 2811 passed / 25 skipped (baseline 2791/23, +20 new unit tests); pnpm depcruise clean (2140 modules). The DB-gated integration test RAN (not skipped) against live Supabase and PASSED both cases: real projected settled Transaction (amount 150000 minor -> 1500 major, currentState derived, .claim excluded, evidenceRef present, buyerRef/method from authority_context) and tenant isolation (merchant B empty list, 403 cross-merchant list, 404 cross-merchant get-by-id). Post-run runtime.* counts re-verified back to 0 (no leftover rows). Test quality confirmed by reading the tests: assertions exercise real projected values and tenant boundaries and would fail if the projection/routes were reverted. Docker build skipped (no app Dockerfile change; slice does not affect image build path).

non_blocking_findings: list can emit duplicate rows if one transaction_id ever yields two workflow_intents (dedup index is on (environment,transaction_id,command_type,command_digest)); dormant today since no writer produces multi-intent transactions.
loadAmount uses ORDER BY id ASC LIMIT 1, so a transaction referenced by multiple spend_ledger rows would pick an arbitrary amount.
list does N+1 queries (per-intent step/amount fetch), up to ~401 round-trips at limit=200; acceptable now, candidate for a future set-based query.
getTransaction route is not yet consumed by the console UI (list-only page); endpoint exists per the fixed api-client contract.
